rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is big, muscular, and robust.

example.english: Their son is really strapping and must be great at sports.
example.traditional: 佢個仔生得好大隻，做運動一定好掂。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 zai2 saang1 dak1 hou2 daai6 zek3 zou6 wan6 dung6 jat1 ding6 hou2 dim6

rows.note: Use this when you want to describe a sturdily built physique in a more polished or descriptive way.

example.english: That actor has a strapping build and looks especially good in a suit.
example.traditional: 嗰位演員身形健碩，著起套西裝特別好睇。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 jin2 jyun4 san1 jing4 gin6 sek6 zoek3 hei2 tou3 sai1 zong1 dak6 bit6 hou2 tai2
